checkFromNote: Entries before this commit recorded the hash of the changelog commit rather than the commit they describe, so they cannot be verified by hash. changelog:check only polices commits after this one.

entries.message: Coding: show Before → Now on a decided proposal, not Current vs Proposed
entries.summary: An accepted definition proposal no longer displays identical text under Current and Proposed: decided rows read the before-text from the decision log and show Before against Now, with the model's original wording kept visible when the researcher edited it.

entries.message: Backfill six missing Change Log entries and make log-change commit its own work
entries.summary: Restores entries for the six commits whose changelog updates were written and then discarded before commit, and makes log-change commit the entry it writes; adds changelog:check and explains why a git post-commit hook is the wrong tool here.

entries.message: Real mode: accept, edit or reject AI-proposed codebook definition changes
entries.summary: Definition proposals from the disagreement diagnostic can be accepted, edited before accepting, or rejected, with every decision logged with before/after text; structural proposals are surfaced as design decisions with no apply action, and no coded segment is ever re-coded.

entries.message: Real mode: allow configuring the OpenAI key, and diagnose blocked requests
entries.summary: The OpenAI key, live-AI toggle and model pickers are available in real mode behind a warning that running the diagnostic transmits participant answer text; a blocked request now reports the three causes that produce Failed to fetch instead of the bare message.

entries.message: Real mode: AI diagnostic for coder disagreements (read-only)
entries.summary: Adds a read-only Coding-page diagnostic that asks the configured OpenAI model why the two coding passes disagree, behind a per-use confirm naming the data transmission; it writes no code, override or definition, and real-mode AI log entries now live in the local-only real slice so prompts quoting participants never sync.

entries.message: Real mode: bulk transcript import from CSV/TSV with a mandatory preview
entries.summary: Adds file-based transcript import for real mode in wide (one row per participant) and long (one row per answer) layouts, with a hand-written RFC 4180 reader, a live-protocol CSV template, a mandatory preview resolving unknown codes, duplicates and existing transcripts, and an all-or-nothing single-commit write.

entries.message: Real mode: edit participant records, including the participant code
entries.summary: Adds a per-row Edit action for real participant records covering code, stakeholder group, role descriptor and tenure band; changing the code carries the denormalised copy on transcripts, coded segments and the override log with it, so no data is orphaned.

entries.message: Real data mode 4/4: confidentiality header on real exports, confirm before export
entries.summary: Real-mode exports carry a confidentiality header instead of the synthetic caveat, name what is being exported before writing the file, and exclude the synthetic corpus; import, live AI, calibration and demo data are unavailable in real mode.

entries.message: Real data mode 3/4: code real transcripts from the text alone
entries.summary: Real-mode coding never consults a pre-assigned hypothesis: both passes classify from the answer text against the whole codebook, unmatched text stays unclassified, and the pages state that two machine passes are not inter-rater reliability.

entries.message: Real data mode 2/4: participant records, transcript entry, mode-scoped nav
entries.summary: Adds pseudonymised real-participant records (no name, no weight profile, no held propositions) and a per-question transcript entry screen with no generation; synthetic and real pages are mutually exclusive in the nav; all analysis reads/writes go through the mode-scoped accessors.

entries.message: Real data mode 1/4: mode + dataset separation
entries.summary: Workspace mode synthetic|real with a separate real slice; activeData()/updateActive() enforce separation at the data layer; real data stripped from remote sync in persist(); mode-specific banner; confirm-gated switch
